Text.Value: Been partying a little hard, have we? Might want to lay off.
There was a time I was on a first name basis with chems. It's better to kiss them goodbye, trust me.
I hope your little habit doesn't interfere with things. Right?
You may want to go easy on that.
Didn't they have those PSAs back in the day? About drugs and the wacky awesome lifestyle they promote?
Now, isn't that just fun to watch. Feeling peppy now?
Easy, tiger. Not everything needs to be shot up.
How Wild West of you.
And we're shooting at what exactly?
Everything looks better at the bottom of a glass, right?
I've been known to partake of that, myself.
That'll take the edge off.
Hey, boss, you mean to drop that?
Pass it my way, I happen to like caps.
You know that's worth something, right?
Wow. Now there's a fashion statement.
I guess subtlety just went out the window.
My, my, how... armored you look.
Yeah. Heights. This'll be "fun."
You know, there's a lot to be said about good old terra firma, right? Right?
This thing is safe, right?
That looks technical.
I never had the patience to much around with terminals.
You done with that yet?
Try "1234." That's hacking gold, there.
You and Tinker Tom should compare notes.
Ahh, terminals. It's like the Old World flipping us off all over again.
I can't believe you survived that jump. You got thrill issues.
Ahh, the time honored tradition of looting.
You might want to wipe off the blood on anything you find there.
We could always use some more ammo.
You're really thorough, you know that?
Anything interesting on 'em?
Whenever you're done corpse squatting, I'm good to go.
Whew. Now that's impressive.
I don't know if even a scavver would take that.
You might want to focus on the valuable salvage. You'll break your back carrying worthless scrap.
That's not even worth picking up, boss.
I love Old World widgets. Worth a fair amount, too.
That'll add some extra oomph to your armor.
Hey, the more firepower you can absorb the better.
Fixing up your armor's always a wise investment.
You can do that? You got to tinker with my guns next.
That was some fine work there. It even looks deadlier.
I could spend hours fiddling with my gun like that. It could save your life.
With skills like that, remind me to show you a couple places.
That is some precision picking there.
Take that, lock.
Now I'm feeling all sorts of uncomfortable about my locker back at HQ.
No lock will stand before us.
Now things are getting interesting.
You know that staticky sound? Yeah, it means we should get the hell out of here.
Ah... radiation. You unbelievable bastard.
That's not a good sound. Let's move it.
We're suckin' up rads here.
Look. Unless you want me to stick you on top of the Railroad's Christmas tree, let's go.
Great. I didn't need to have more children.
It's Rad Away time.
Check in with Carrington. The bastard will charge you for it, but he can decontaminate you.
Rad sickness. That's a good look.
I'm a fan of Grognak myself. What will that wacky barbarian do next?
Any good?
That issue's one of my favorites.
Nice moves there.
C'mon in, the water's glowing.
Yay. Slime.
Let's get the dog paddling over with.
What we building today?
Can you build me a mansion? Casa del Deacon.
You've got a real knack for construction.
You might want to cover up. Or not.
Your fashion choice there, that takes some chutzpah.
Seriously, you're not cold?
With you overloaded and all, let me take this chance to read my unabridged copy of "War and Peace" at you.
How can you even walk like that?
I could, I guess, carry some of that for you.
Are you trying to impress someone? C'mon, drop some of that.
I'm surprised you can even walk with all that.
I'm convincing the next raw recruit I'm actually President Eden. Think I can pull it off?
You really like to wander, don't you? I've seen more of the 'Wealth with you than I have in the rest of my years combined.
The way you just walk right out in the open. It's a wonder you're head hasn't been blown off by a sniper. Just saying.
You getting the hang of the Railroad yet? We're one big dysfunctional family. With guns.
Sometimes it's hard to take Dez seriously. I remember her when she was a green recruit.
I'm a sucker for those Old World books. It must've been somethin' livin' back then.
Don't ever let your guard down. When you do, inevitably that's when everything goes to hell.
Instinct is a powerful tool in our business. Rely on it, train it up. It'll save your life. Promise.
I've had this mug for too long. Might be time for a new face.
Please, you do the talking. If I pick anything up, I'll let you know afterwards.
The Commonwealth can be the enemy just as much as the Institute. We've lost plenty of synths to hate mongers.
I never really much cared for the Minutemen. The idea sounds great, but you give small men big power and sometimes you'll pay for it.
Keep your eye out for Rail Signs. Besides the goodie bags tourists and agents have left valuable intel.
A lot of our people help us once, maybe twice a month. If that. You've jumped right into the deep end.
This partnering up. It's weird. Sometimes I just want to pop a Stealth Boy and bug out. Not really an option now.
I wish Dez would green light the occasional mission to help out humans. Sometimes just a little bit of help goes a long way.
One time, I got a face change and was a girl for a few months. Yeah, you should've seen the looks back at HQ.
One day the Railroad's number will be up. I thought that day had come at the Switchboard. I can't shake the feeling we're living on borrowed time.
Did I ever tell you about the time I was in Capital Wasteland? Now there's a tale.
I'm thinking next time I go to town I'll dress up as a Mr. Handy. If I pull that off I'll be a legend.
If we take out the Institute someday, I wonder what we'd do. Hell, synths got it bad enough even without them. It'd keep us busy.
I'm in the mood for... some Blamco Mac n' Cheese. Or maybe mirelurk steaks with salsa. Mmmm.
The Brotherhood. In Capital Wasteland, they really weren't bad. But now.
I really want to know how the Big One started. What idiot fired first? Why? What the hell did they think they'd gain?
The big three for predicting people: caps, beliefs, and ego. Get a handle on what's driving someone and you know where you stand.
Am I the only one that thinks this is all insane?
Better keep your iron strapped on. Friendly advice.
It's been a long time since I've been here.
What a day, huh?
A stealth boy, my best pal, and a world full of danger... This is the good life.
How inviting.
Probably some good salvage in here.
Now we just need a picnic basket.
Remember, fill your pockets with all the goodies. Then we can slowly crawl out. Good times.
Remind me why we're crawling around this god-forsaken place?
So here we are. Just soaking in the moment. Nice.
Appreciating the moment really is a lost art.
The places we go.
We go to the most interesting places.
Anyone up for some meditation?
The trick to this is don't die.
I was hoping they'd be all dead by now.
You know, running away is always an option. I won't shoot. Promise.
This is the part where you're supposed to die.
Fighting is so 2077.
Now, this, this is a workout.
And here I was wanting to spend the day reading Proust. And then you have to ruin it.
Everyone stop. I got a splinter.
This is only going to end one way.
Yeah, so this is happening.
You're blocking my light, man.
Super Mutants hit like a mac truck.
I got your back.
Look out!
And this is why we can't have nice things.
Let me try something.
Dear god, we're dead.
Now, insert slot A into tab B, right?
I so prefer a gun.
Directions: apply repetitively until dead.
This is a little close for comfort.
It's fighting time.
Fighting again. Great.
I should have a battle cry.
Wrong move, pal.
You know ammo isn't cheap. Can we just pay you to play dead?
You're going down. Grrr. That's menacing, right?
Insert something Shakespearian involving death and your inevitable doom here.
I'm ready for 'em.
You know I do like long, lazy, dull days, right?
Time to earn our paychecks. I'm getting paid, right?
Buddy, I need to be a lot more high or a lot more drunk to be bothered right now.
Need a place to stay? Try Hotel Rexford.
Let's get this over with.
What shennanigans are we up to today?
God damned raiders.
Raiders, raiders, and yet more damned raiders.
More ferals. Great.
I call dibs on any hats. I love a good hat.
Fun times incoming.
Look alive. Bad guys incoming.
This is going to be good.
Well, this is going to be exciting.
We live to fight another day. And night. And day. Et cetera.
Well, that got the blood pumping.
We sure do a lot of that. Winning, that is.
Let's see if they left anything useful for us.
Traveling with you ain't dull, I'll say that.
You know, you're really good at this. Too good.
Back before I met you I'd go whole days without massacring a bunch of things. Honest.
So, new business model. We team up with a mortuary. You see where I'm going with this, right?
We made that look easy.
We win. Again.
Tell your friends, you dead bastard. We'll be here all week.
Do you ever just feel sorry for the poor bastards that fight us? They don't stand a chance.
We do good work, you know?
I wonder what they left us.
Now that's getting it done.
I'm usually not a fan of wanton slaughter. But I feel pretty good about this.
There goes my appetite.
Yeah, sure, dig in, pal.
You aren't seriously...? Yes, yes, you are.
